conclusion.rationale: Static analysis confirmed 2 compatibility changes: (1) HIGH: bond_option_xmit_hash_policy_set now rejects vlan+srcmac xmit_hash_policy when XDP is loaded on 802.3ad/balance-xor bonds via EOPNOTSUPP, affecting sysfs (/sys/class/net/<bond>/bonding/xmit_hash_policy) and netlink (IFLA_BOND_XMIT_HASH_POLICY) interfaces; (2) LOW: new __bond_xdp_check API symbol added to bonding.h (additive only). Dynamic testing was limited by kernel version mismatch - the analysis worktree uses v7.2-rc code that cannot be built against host kernel 6.8.0. Test entry scripts and contract probes have been generated and are ready for execution in a matching VM. Build was attempted 2 times with different strategies; both failed due to struct/API differences between kernel versions.
